comment: Invented legacy session fixtures for task 1.3 of the adopt-resource-session-planning OpenSpec change. Every string is invented and English-only. No source corpus text, no real names, no machine paths, no personal data. Three workflow kinds are covered: text-to-image, editing (edit) and guided (guide).

sessions.name: invented t2i studio portrait
sessions.look: A small studio with a bare grey backdrop. Soft light from a single large window falls on her right cheek. She wears her hair loose, brushed forward over one shoulder, with no makeup beyond a faint pink lip
sessions.wardrobe: a thin grey linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbows, dark cotton trousers, bare feet

shots.label: wide
shots.prompt: standing square to the camera with her hands at her sides, full body in frame

shots.label: jacket on
shots.prompt: turned three quarters to the camera, one hand on her hip, the other raised to her collar
shots.wardrobe: the same grey linen shirt, dark cotton trousers, a loose dark jacket over the shirt, bare feet

shots.label: explicit trigger
shots.prompt: close-up of {trigger}, the camera centred on her face

shots.label: no clothes at all
shots.prompt: kneeling upright on the floor, both hands resting on her thighs

shots.label: more like this
shots.prompt: a quiet portrait of a stone staircase at dusk, framed from the foot of the steps
